video_prompt: Locked-off static camera, side view. A small ball is released from rest and falls straight downward under gravity. The entire measured fall stays inside the frame, and the ball does not reach or touch the ground during the clip. The camera does not move, pan, or zoom. Plain flat background, no other objects, nothing enters the frame.

proxy.M2_combination: 本题辅助指标只有一个子项，q_M2 即该子项的 physics_score

M1.measures: CV(dv_y): equal-interval vertical velocity increments should be constant
M1.score_rule: 提取失败：physics_score 记 null，不给识别分，proxy_score = 0（SCORING_RULES_V2 §3.1）
M1.principle: Free fall has constant acceleration, so the change in vertical velocity over successive equal time intervals is the same every time. The metric is CV(dv_y) = std/mean of those increments; exact free fall gives 0.
M1.note: ball fell only 21.2 px over the tracked span, no measurable fall

M2.score_rule: 提取失败：physics_score 记 null，不给识别分，proxy_score = 0（SCORING_RULES_V2 §3.1）
M2.principle: Starting from rest, the distances fallen in three consecutive equal time intervals are in the ratio 1:3:5. The metric is the RMS relative deviation of the measured dy2/dy1 and dy3/dy1 from 3 and 5.
M2.note: ball fell only 21.2 px over the tracked span, no measurable fall

scene.phase_note: frames outside the free-fall phase (held at rest, or resting after landing) are excluded
